About me

A Space for You to Feel Heard and Supported

I bring clinical expertise, corporate experience, and a practical perspective to trauma-informed care for adults and couples.

My commitment to wellness

Compassionate support grounded in real life

My background includes more than a decade of clinical experience and more than a decade in corporate operations. Together, those experiences help me understand both your internal emotional landscape and the very real pressures of work, relationships, and daily life.

Whether you are working through trauma, navigating challenges in your relationship, or simply feeling stuck, you do not have to carry it alone. I would be honored to partner with you on your path to healing.

Request a consultation

Come as you are

Care built on comfort, trust, and privacy

You deserve a counseling space where you can relax, breathe, and be present. My approach is confidential, secure, professional, and paced for you.

Sessions are available in person one day a week in North Scottsdale and through secure telehealth for clients located anywhere in Arizona or New Mexico.
